# Document Index for AI Assistants

- **GUI server endpoints?** Check [GUI architecture](gui-architecture.md) for dual-location setup
- **YAML step types?** See [llmflow-language.md](../llmflow-language.md) - don't reinvent `for-each` or `append_to`
